summary: A short opening offers a first committee post with an obligation to bring another body's business back home.
realLife: In March the 31st District chair described short remaining terms representing the district at either county party, with an executive board seat and a duty to attend and report back.
inGame: needs: unexpired term and reporting obligation.

turns.pulledBy: The member can attend both sets of meetings.
turns.what: They offer to fill the remaining term.
turns.writesBack: The district has someone responsible for a county report.

turns.pulledBy: The county meeting conflicts with the member's work.
turns.what: The member declines the seat but offers local help.
turns.writesBack: The short term still needs a representative.
